name: Pro Shooter VR
detailed_description:
Pro Shooter VR is the world’s first Olympic-style precision shooting sports game in VR. Challenge yourself in a shooting simulation like never before!

EXPERIENCE REALISTIC PRECISION SHOOTING FOR THE FIRST TIME IN VR

Focus, aim, and make every shot count! Test your endurance, accuracy, and mental resilience.

PLAY OLYMPIC-STYLE SHOOTING SPORTS

Experience what it's like to be a shooting athlete in 10m Air Rifle, 10m Air Pistol, and 25m Rapid Fire.

MODIFY DIFFICULTY

Whether you are a professional in the sport or an amateur playing for the first time, we have difficulty modes tailor-made for you to enjoy.

PLAY ACROSS MULTIPLE RANGES

Participate in a wide variety of shooting ranges and game events.

PRACTICE FOR EXCELLENCE

Improve your gameplay with in-game tutorial videos and a practice range.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590/AMD FX8350 equivalent or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA Geforce GTX 970, AMD Radeon R9 290 equivalent or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • VR Support: Steam VR
  • Additional Notes: 1x USB 2.0 or newer, HDMI 1.4, Display port 1.2 or newer
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590/AMD FX8350 equivalent or better
  • Graphics: NVIDIA Geforce GTX 1060, AMD Radeon RX480 equivalent or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • VR Support: Steam VR
  • Additional Notes: 1x USB 2.0 or newer, HDMI 1.4, Display port 1.2 or newer
